import json,hashlib,time,resource,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from pipeline.native_range_grid import native_range_grid,gather_range_features
start=time.monotonic();shape_index=json.loads(Path('/tmp/native-shapes/shapes.json').read_text());shapes={(r['context'],r['timestamp'],r['laser'],r['return']):r['native_shape'] for r in shape_index['rows']}
report=json.loads(Path('/source/reconstruction/report.json').read_text());points=records=annotated=eligible=0;grids=[]
for r in report['rows']:
 p=Path('/source/reconstruction')/r['artifact'];assert hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as a:
  identity={k:r[k] for k in ['context','timestamp','laser','return','motion']};identity['pixels']=a['pixels']
  targets={'segmentation':a['segmentation']} if r['segmentation_present'] else {}
  record={'identity':identity,'return_present':True,'observations':{'physical_features':a['physical_features'],'xyz':a['xyz']},'targets':targets,'evaluation':{'nlz':a['nlz']}}
  grid=native_range_grid(record,shapes[(r['context'],r['timestamp'],r['laser'],r['return'])])
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(gather_range_features(grid,grid['measurements']),a['physical_features'])
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(gather_range_features(grid,grid['source_indices']),np.arange(r['points']))
  assert int(grid['valid'].sum())==r['points'];assert np.all(grid['measurements'][~grid['valid']]==0)
  assert grid['annotation_present']==r['segmentation_present']
  expected=int(np.count_nonzero(a['segmentation'][:,1])) if r['segmentation_present'] else 0
  assert int(grid['semantic_supervised'].sum())==expected
  eligible+=expected;points+=r['points'];records+=1;annotated+=r['segmentation_present']
assert points==report['points'] and records==3970
v={'records':records,'points':points,'annotated_returns':annotated,'eligible_point_elements':eligible,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'scope':'two engineering scenes; native grid/point identity roundtrip only; no trained frontend or scientific accuracy result'}
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2));print('PASS complete native range grid roundtrip',v)
